source: Gemma 4 E4B develop answers from the 2026-10-24 fresh-concept QA runs (r1 market, r3 canyon, r4 railway, r5 jazz), verbatim

ideas.railway: Snowy mountain railway platform at dawn: a uniformed conductor helps a young traveller lift a heavy leather trunk onto an old steam train; breath fogging, steam drifting across the platform lamps.
ideas.market: Rainy night market in a coastal Asian city: a teenage courier on a bicycle weaves between food stalls under neon signs, steam rising from the woks, puddles reflecting the lights.
ideas.jazz: A smoky 1950s jazz club: a singer in a sequinned gown at a vintage ribbon microphone, a piano-bass-drums trio playing behind her, a single spotlight cutting through the smoke, couples listening at small candlelit tables.
ideas.canyon: Desert canyon at harsh noon: two kids, a girl of about ten and her younger brother, race a scruffy dog toward a rusted water tank; heat shimmer, red rock walls, dust kicking up.
